Additionally, Marico has initiated a consumer trust-building program by providing quality certificates for Saffola Honey, which is manufactured in a USFDA registered plant and compliant with FSSAI norms.

Marico also highlights its rigorous quality control processes and the transparency of its testing results through the Saffola Honey Certificate of Purity.
